notes.title_en: Formal chapters: anchor each §53 dimension to §52 rows
notes.title_zh: 正式章节：将每个 §53 维度锚定到 §52 行
notes.body_en: For every content dimension in §53, pull the closest §52 rows and the §7.1 works used to close them. The chapter should show analysis role -> verified anchor -> field calibration, mirroring the drafted document so nothing new is asserted.
notes.body_zh: 对 §53 的每个内容维度,取最相关的 §52 行以及用于闭合它们的 §7.1 文献。章节应呈现「分析作用 → 核验锚点 → 田野校准」的结构,与起草稿保持一致,不断言任何新事实。

notes.body_en: Does the drafting loop stay honest when the criterion circle is small and the corpus is closed? Open task: write a short self-audit pass (like Lynn's style-check) over the drafted chapters before they are promoted.
notes.body_zh: 当判准循环很小、语料库已闭合时,起草回路是否仍然诚实?待办任务:在章节转正前,对起草稿做一次简短的自审(类似 Lynn 的文体检查)。

notes.title_zh: Kinda 闸门管理员谈「再生」
notes.body_en: Capture candidate interview snippets on canal regeneration; check against what the written record says about who maintains the lock. Possible entry point for the fieldwork cycles' discussion.
notes.body_zh: 收集关于运河再生的候选访谈片段;与文字记录中关于闸门维护者的表述对勘。可作为田野周期讨论的切入点。
